SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date October 27, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature] C.S.I.

The situation in the various departments of
the Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
Zung Ching Loh (陳慶祿) at present lying
in the Sacred Heart Hospital continues to improve slowly.
There is now every hope of his recovery.
It is learned that three Chinese, Yuan Li
Teng (袁履登), Chinese member of the S.M.C., Yu Ya
Ching (虞洽卿), also a member of the S.M.C., and another
who was not named visited Mr. A.D. Bell in the Council
Chambers on October 25 and offered their services in the
settlement of the Shanghai Power Company labour dispute.
The Company decided on October 26 to issue
letters, through the Foreigners in charge of departments
to the senior Chinese employees and workers, now on strike,
requesting them to call at the homes of the said Foreigners
where they will receive certain important information.
The information to be given them will be to the effect that
the Company although realising that 70% or 80% of the
workmen do not want to continue the strike, they (the Company)
will not be able to keep their jobs open for an indefinite
period. The scheme is not as it would appear an effort
themselves of their obligations
on the part of the management to unburden/to their employees.
The senior employees backed by a large percentage of the
workers now on strike have approached the management indirectly
asking that they be called back to work.
It is the intention of the workers who wish
to resume work to explain to the Union that the strike
having produced no beneficial result and they having wives
and families to support it is their intention to resume

日期：1933年10月27日。

主题（全称）上海电力公司——局势。

由特别科督察长 Golder 撰写 经由 [签名] 首席特别科督察转呈

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。
陈庆禄（Zung Ching Loh）目前躺在圣心医院，病情继续缓慢好转。
现在他康复的希望很大。
据悉，三名华人，即工部局华董袁履登（Yuan Li Teng）、同为工部局华董的虞洽卿（Yu Ya Ching），以及另一名未具名人士，于10月25日在议事厅拜访了 A.D. Bell 先生，并表示愿意协助解决上海电力公司的劳资纠纷。
公司于10月26日决定，通过各部门的外籍负责人向目前正在罢工的高级华员和工人发出信函，要求他们前往上述外籍负责人的寓所，在那里他们将接收某些重要信息。
向他们提供的信息大意是：公司虽然意识到70%或80%的工人不希望继续罢工，但公司无法无限期地为它们保留职位。这一计划并非如表面所示，是管理层试图推卸其对员工的义务。
得到大部分罢工工人支持的高级员工已间接接触管理层，要求让他们复工。
希望复工的工人打算向工会解释，鉴于罢工未产生有益结果，且他们需要供养妻室家属，因此他们打算复工，

The Shanghai Power Company Employees' Lien
Yih Club, with an office at 84 Kang Ka Loong, inside the
Small East Gate, was dissolved on October 26. This
organization had practically no support from the clerical
staff of the Company and was more or less in the hands of
agitators including Wu Tso-bei (吳祖培). Since the
attempted murder of Chen Ching-loh on October 20, Wu Tso-bei
has not been seen, and seeing that it was his efforts that
kept the club going his disappearance has resulted in its
failure.

Date October. 25. 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company- Situation

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by [Signature]

The situation in the various departments
of the Shanghai Power Company shows no change during the past
twenty four hours.

Zung Ching Loh, ( 陳慶祥 ) employee
of the Company who was shot and wounded on October 20 remains
alive , but shows little improvement. Discreet enquiries
are being made in conjunction with the Yangtszepoo Station
detectives so far, however, no useful information has come to
hand.

With reference to my report dated October
23, paragraph 6. The two representatives of the strikers who
visited Mr A.D.Bell, Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Council
on October 21, were Chu Hao Sung ( 朱浩生 ) ex-worker at
Riverside Power Station, member of the Workers Strike-Committee
and leader of the Secret Investigation Group, and Hsu Sung Zung
( ) hitherto not mentioned as being an active member
of the strikers. After some discussion as to their dispute
with the Management of the Company the two representatives
handed to Mr Bell the following demands:

(I) That notices making clear the conditions of service with
the Company be posted in the various plants and premises.

(2) That the Company should desist from dismissing old hands
for petty offences.

(3) That pay should be paid for the period of the strike
( Mr A.D. Bell is of the opinion that something less than
full pay would be accepted ).

(4) That all workers dismissed as the result of this strike
be paid their full gratuities, etc.

Mr Bell informed the two men that he would bring their demands

主题（全称）上海电力公司——局势

由特别科督察长 Golder 撰写。经由 [签名] 转呈

在过去二十四小时内，上海电力公司各部门的局势没有变化。

该公司雇员陈庆祥（Zung Ching Loh，原文如此，前文作陈庆禄）于10月20日遭枪击受伤，目前仍存活，但病情鲜有改善。正与杨树浦警署侦探合作进行谨慎查访，然而截至目前，尚未获得有用情报。

关于我10月23日报告的第6段。10月21日拜访上海公共租界工部局总董 A.D. Bell 先生的两名罢工代表，分别是前江边电厂工人、工人罢工委员会成员兼秘密调查组组长朱浩生（Chu Hao Sung），以及此前未被提及为罢工活跃分子的徐松宗（Hsu Sung Zung，中文名空缺）。在就他们与公司管理层的纠纷进行了一番讨论后，这两名代表向 Bell 先生提交了以下要求：

(1) 在各厂房和场所张贴明确公司在职条件的通告。

(2) 公司应停止因轻微过失解雇老员工。

(3) 应支付罢工期间的工资（A.D. Bell 先生认为，低于全额工资的数额也可被接受）。

(4) 所有因本次罢工而被解雇的工人应获得全额遣散费等。

Bell 先生告知这两人，他将把他们的要求

At about 12 noon on October 24. ten
senior employees from the Fearon Road Depot went to No 766 Rue
Lafayette where they were interviewed by Mr Ivanoff an employee
of the Shanghai Power Company. One of the workmen chosen as
spokesman stated that about seventy of his men were willing
to resume work if the Company would give them sufficient
protection from the interference of the strike-pickets. The
callers also inferred that if they were able to return to work
without incident they were sure that 80 of 90% of the men on
strike would return within the next few days. Mr Ivanoff
informed the men that the Company would take every precaution
to ensure their safety whilst at work and that everything would
be done to ensure the safety of their families.

when the matter of the protection was
brought to my notice by Mr Heald I informed him that I would
explain the circumstances under which the men were to resume
to the Officer i/c Special Branch but that I could not state
whether it would be possible to render some 1.000 men protection.

As practically all the men who wish to
resume live in the wayside, hongkew and kashing road districts
I advised that the men be instructed to proceed to work in
groups as large as possible so as to make it more difficult
for isolated pickets to attack single members of the Company's
staff.

10月24日中午12时许，十名来自斐伦路（Fearon Road）仓库的高级员工前往拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）766号，上海电力公司雇员 Ivanoff 先生在那里接见了他们。一名被选为发言人的工人表示，如果公司能给予他们足够的保护，使其免受罢工纠察队的干扰，他手下的约七十人愿意复工。来访者还暗示，如果他们能够平安无事地返回工作岗位，他们确信80%至90%的罢工工人将在未来几天内复工。Ivanoff 先生告知这些人，公司将采取一切预防措施以确保他们在工作时的安全，并将尽一切努力确保其家属的安全。

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by.
in connection with the Shanghai Power Company
labour dispute, the following news item (translation
attached) appeared in the October 25th Issue of the
Central China Daily News and other vernacular newspapers:
"At the request of various public bodies, the
"Shanghai Municipal Council has undertaken the
"mediation. At 3 p.m. yesterday, Mr. Messenden,
"Secretary General of the Council, invited
"Mr. Doo Yueh-sung, member of the Council of
"the Chinese Municipality, to discuss ways and
"means to settle the trouble".
Efforts have been made to verify this report
from outside sources without success.
The Doo Yueh-sung referred to in the news
item is the leader of one of the most powerful of the
Frenchtown gangs of loafers and wields no uncertain power
among local "racketeering" circles. One source of
his income is the settlement "by strong arms method"
of labour disputes which in not a few instances have
been created by his followers.
D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
Commr. of Police.

Information, The report in the newspaper being unimportant O. i/c S. B.

Central Chin Daily News and other local newspapers:
LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER COMPANY.

With reference to the labour trouble in
the Shanghai Power Company, Pao Kuo-hwa, the special
deputy of the Ministry of Industry, has sent a
telegraphic report to the Ministry on his investigations
into the dispute. He will return to Nanking as soon
as his mission has been carried out.

At the request of various public bodies,
the Shanghai Municipal Council has undertaken the
mediation. At 3 p.m. yesterday, Mr. Fessénn,
Secretary-General of the Council, invited Mr. Doo
Yueh-sin, member of the Council of the Chinese
Municipality, to discuss ways and means to settle
the trouble.

It is reported that the General Labour
Union will call a meeting of various labour unions
at 2 p.m. to-day in its premises on Foh Yeu Road,
Nantao, at which definite measures to render assistance
to the workers will be discussed.

Shun Pao.

The Shanghai Electrical Goods Trade
Association yesterday sent the following letter to
the Shanghai Power Company:-
The labour dispute in your Company has lasted
thirty days. This is indeed most unfortunate and
we regret to hear of it. All our members are paying
close attention to this matter. Many members of our
Association have received complaints from their
customers about delays in the installation of electric
lights and making connections. This has caused great
inconvenience to our business. We have to request
you to settle the dispute peacefully as soon as possible.
As our business is closely related with
that of your Company, we write this to advise you and
hope you will not misunderstand our attitude.

A Correction.

The Social Bureau sent the following letter
to the "Chen Pao" on October 24:-
The report published by your paper to-day
about the labour trouble in the Shanghai Power Company
is not correct.
This Bureau is an official organ dealing
with labour troubles in this city. We held a meeting
on October 23 with representatives of workers of the
Shanghai Power Company. Only Pao Kuo-hwa, representing
the Ministry of Industry, and the representatives of
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang attended.
No delegates of any other bodies were present.
Please make a correction.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：
上海电力公司的劳工局势。

关于上海电力公司的劳资纠纷，实业部特派专员鲍国华已向部里发送电报，汇报他对此次纠纷的调查情况。一旦完成任务，他将返回南京。

应各公共团体的请求，上海公共租界工部局已承担调解工作。昨日下午3时，工部局秘书长 Fessénn 先生邀请华界市议会委员杜月辛（Doo Yueh-sin，音译，疑为杜月笙之误）先生，讨论解决纠纷的办法。

据报道，总工会将于今天下午2点在其南市福佑路的会所召开各工会会议，讨论援助工人的具体措施。

《申报》。

上海电气商品同业公会昨日致函上海电力公司如下：
贵公司的劳资纠纷已持续三十天。这确实非常不幸，我们对此深感遗憾。我们会所有会员都在密切关注此事。本会许多会员收到客户关于电灯安装和接线延误的投诉。这给我们的业务造成了极大不便。我们恳请贵公司尽快和平解决纠纷。
由于我们的业务与贵公司的业务密切相关，特此致函劝告，希望不要误解我们的态度。

更正。

社会局于10月24日致函《晨报》如下：
贵报今日刊登的关于上海电力公司劳资纠纷的报道不实。
本局是处理本市劳资纠纷的官方机构。我们于10月23日与上海电力公司工人代表举行了会议。只有代表实业部的鲍国华和上海特别区国民党代表出席。没有其他团体的代表在场。
请予更正。

Date October 23, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature]

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
Zung Ching Ioh (陳慶祿), wounded employee of
the Shanghai Power Company, is still alive but his condition
shows no further improvement.
The 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union issued an order on October 22 forbidding any
non-member or person not concerned with the Union affairs
from entering the office of the Union at 15 Shou Ying Faung,
Tien Doong Road, Chapei.
The staff members of the Union claimed that the
step to ban strangers from the Union was necessary owing to
the serious situation. They also intimated that in view of
the activities of spies of the Management, pickets would be
detailed to keep a watch in the vicinity of the lodging houses
where Strike Committee or other important members are staying.
Representatives of the strikers secured, as secret
bases, rooms in the following places :-
(1) An Loh Lodging House, 10 Tai Yuen Fang, Rue de
Weikwe (Room Number unknown).
(2) Asia Lodging House, 135 Avenue Edward VII, (Room 530).
(3) Kiu Foh Lodging House, West Kao Di Li, Rue de Saigon.
The only person recognised as the result of observation on
these bases was Tai Jen-heng (戴仁恒), member of the
Strike Committee, who was seen to enter Room 350 of the Asia
Lodging House.
Representatives of the strikers called on Mr. A.D.Bell,
Chairman of the S.M.C. at the Chambers on Saturday, October 21.
Mr. Bell asked them questions as to the shooting of Zung Ching

主题（全称）上海电力公司 - 局势

由 特别调查员 Golder 制作 转呈 [签名]

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。
上海电力公司受伤雇员陈庆祿（Zung Ching Ioh）仍然在世，但其状况未见进一步好转。
第四区水电工会于10月22日发布命令，禁止任何非会员或与工会事务无关的人员进入位于闸北天潼路寿英坊15号的工会办公室。
工会职员声称，鉴于局势严重，禁止外人进入工会是必要之举。他们还暗示，鉴于资方间谍的活动，将指派纠察队在罢工委员会或其他重要成员居住的旅馆附近进行监视。
罢工代表在以下地点获取房间作为秘密基地：
(1) 安禄旅馆，魏克威路（Rue de Weikwe）太源坊10号（房间号不详）。
(2) 亚洲旅馆，爱德华七世路135号（530室）。
(3) 久福旅馆，西贡路（Rue de Saigon）西高地利（West Kao Di Li）。
通过对这些基地的观察，唯一被识别的人是戴仁恒（Tai Jen-heng），罢工委员会成员，有人看见他进入亚洲旅馆350室。
罢工代表于10月21日星期六在市政厅拜访了工部局董事会主席 A.D. Bell 先生。
Bell 先生就10月20日星期五陈庆

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Jw. Prince

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
Zung Ching Loh (陳慶祿), Shanghai Power
Company employee, who was shot and wounded on October 20
and who is at present in the Sacred Heart Hospital, is
reported to have made a slight improvement during the past
24 hours.
Careful watch is being maintained from this
office, in co-operation with Yangtszepoo Station, for the
assailants of Zung.
Copies of photographs of Wu Tsoo Bei (吳祖培),
ex-clerk of the Shanghai Power Company, implicated in the
shooting of Zung Ching Loh, have been distributed to
Chinese members of the Special Branch, S.1, so as to
facilitate co-operation with the Station concerned.
At 4.25 p.m. October 21, report was made to
Pootoo Road Station that damage to the extent of $10.00
had been caused by some person or persons unknown to
certain switch gear on Shanghai Power Company pole No.
D.E.E. 45, situated at Robison Road, West of Kiaochow Road.
The matter was brought to the notice of the company who
have undertaken the necessary repairs.

Information obtained by Agent 59.
In connection with the Shanghai Power Company
labour dispute, the Ministry of Industry of the National
Government has sent a delegate named Pao Kuo-hwa (包國華)
to Shanghai to mediate for a settlement.
He visited the Bureau of Social Affairs at 2 p.m.
October 21 when he examined reports made by the Bureau on

涉及枪击陈庆祿的前上海电力公司职员吴祖培（Wu Tsoo Bei）的照片副本已分发给特别分署 S.1 的华籍警员，以便与相关分署合作。

此事已提请公司注意，公司已承诺进行必要的维修。

据悉，当地国民党正安排召开第四区水电工会代表会议，定于10月23日在西大门汤浦总部举行，届时中国当局将就上海电力公司雇员近期遭枪击一事进行调查，并与他们讨论为促成其与资方纠纷的解决而应采取的措施。

10月21日晚9时30分至10时45分之间，五个本地同乡会的代表以及总工会的一名代表在西藏路480号的宁波同乡会举行会议。自称代表潮州同乡会的郑正秋（Dzung Tsung-tsiu）担任主席。会议决定致函第四区水电工会，表达本地各同乡会对电力公司罢工者的同情。

Special Branch,
October 20, 1933.

Shanghai Power Company - Shooting of Employee

At 8.25 a.m. October 20, Tung Ching-loh
(陳慶祿), Stores Accountant's Clerk of the Shanghai
Power Company, left his home at 17 Ah Tong Ka Loong (?),
City, to proceed to work. He had only proceeded
a few yards when he was met by six or seven men who
pushed him towards a waiting private motor car ?
(number unknown). All got in and rode for about a
half mile when the car was stopped at the request of
one of the passengers, who got out and telephoned
for another car. Upon the arrival of the second
vehicle (a Ford) the party divided themselves between
the two cars and proceeded by various roads to a point
about a half mile north of the Ying Hsiang Kiang Village
on the Ya Ngock San Road. The cars were stopped,
the party dismounted and the cars were dismissed. As
soon as the conveyances had got out of sight two of the
men drew pistols and fired at Tung Ching-loh. The
party of men then apparently dispersed and the wounded
man lay for some time on the roadside. Some while
later he was seen by a pedestrian who called a ricksha
and conveyed the man to the Settlement. At the Police
Telephone Box, Ying Hsiang Kiang Village, the wounded man
and his rescuer were met by S.P.M. Cavendish attached
to Yangtszepoo Station, who took them to the Sacred
Heart Hospital. Tung Ching-loh is suffering from a
bullet wound in the left side of the chest near the
heart, and another in the groin, whilst his scalp shows
several lacerated wounds.

（批：in Chinese territory about from the Settlement boundary, W/S）

1933年10月20日。

上海电力公司 - 雇员遭枪击事件

10月20日上午8时25分，上海电力公司总务处会计科职员陈慶祿（Tung Ching-loh (陳慶祿)）离开位于华界阿同卡弄17号（17 Ah Tong Ka Loong (?)）的住所去上班。他刚走出几码远，就遇到六七名男子，将他推向一辆等候的私人汽车？（号码不详）。所有人上车后行驶了约半英里，其中一名乘客要求停车，下车打电话叫另一辆车。第二辆车（一辆福特车）到达后，这群人分乘两辆车，经由多条道路前往亚诺克山路（Ya Ngock San Road）上应祥江村（Ying Hsiang Kiang Village）以北约半英里处。车辆停下，众人下车并遣散车辆。交通工具刚一驶离视线，其中两名男子拔出手枪向陈慶祿射击。随后这群人似乎四散而去，伤者躺在路边一段时间。过了一会儿，一名行人发现了他，叫了一辆黄包车将此人送往租界。在应祥江村的警用电话亭处，伤者和救助者遇到了隶属于杨树浦分局的特别警员 Cavendish，他将他们送往仁济医院。陈慶祿左胸近心脏处有一处枪伤，腹股沟处有一处枪伤，头皮有多处撕裂伤。

（批注：在华界，距租界边界约，西/南）

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, October 20, 1933

Non-Strike Clerk
'Taken For Ride'

Power Company Worker
Found Shot Through,
Probably Fatally

Guns of a Chinese Mafia barked out their defiance of the Shanghai Power Company early today when Chen Ching-loh, one of the clerical employees who had refused to join the power company strike, was "taken for a ride."

He was picked up along the Ward Road extension leading to Ying Hsiang Kiang, about 500 yards outside the International Settlement boundary, and taken to the Sacred Heart Hospital. There he was found to be suffering from bullet wounds in the abdomen and chest, and was not expected to live.

Tobacco Workers "Pay A Call"
Aside from this development of violence, the situation in both the power companies and the British Cigaret Company strikes was stated to be the same this morning as yesterday. About 150 strikers entered the Tientsin Road plant of the tobacco company this morning, stayed about a half hour and then departed. It is understood that the direct negotiations between the strikers and the management, which were to have commenced yesterday afternoon, have not yet taken place.

Although there have been a number of coercive incidents in the strike, the shooting of Chen, which is believed to have occurred some time last night, is the first report that the thugs whose hand has been seen behind the strike have resorted to extreme violence. Those in close touch with the situation were of the theory today that the thugs had followed Chen to his home in Native City yesterday afternoon when he quit the power offices at the conclusion of his day's work.

Employee Kidnapped
Once inside the territory of the Native City, the thugs kidnapped the power employee, taking him away in an automobile. The victim was taken across French and International Settlement territory, it is believed, and dumped out of the car when about 500 yards outside the Settlement boundary at Ward Road.

As to when or where the shooting occurred little was known today.
Shanghai Municipal Council intervention into the labor dispute at the power plants has been demanded by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce in a communication addressed to the Council.

(印：JAB 20/10)

7459
《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1933年10月20日，星期五

非罢工职员
“被拉去兜风”

电力公司工人
被发现身中数枪，
可能致命

今天清晨，当一名拒绝加入电力公司罢工的文职雇员陈慶祿（Chen Ching-loh）被“拉去兜风”时，中国黑帮的枪支发出了他们对上海电力公司的挑衅吼声。

他在通往应祥江的华德路延伸段，距国际租界边界约500码处被带走，并被送往仁济医院。在那里，他被发现腹部和胸部中弹，预计无法存活。

烟草工人“上门拜访”
除了这一暴力事件外，据悉今早两家电力公司和英商烟草公司（British Cigaret Company）罢工的局势与昨日相同。约150名罢工者今早进入该公司天津路工厂，停留约半小时后离开。据悉，原定于昨天下午开始的罢工者与管理层之间的直接谈判尚未进行。

尽管罢工期间发生过多起胁迫事件，但被认为发生在昨晚某时的陈氏枪击案，是关于幕后黑手诉诸极端暴力的第一份报告。今天，密切关注局势的人士认为，黑帮分子昨天下午在陈结束一天工作离开电力办公室时，一路跟踪他回到了华界的家中。

雇员被绑架
一旦进入华界地盘，黑帮分子便绑架了这名电力公司员工，用汽车将其带走。据信，受害者被带穿过法租界和国际租界区域，并在华德路距租界边界约500码处被扔下车。

至于枪击发生的时间或地点，今天知之甚少。
华人总商会在致工部局的函件中，要求工部局介入电力厂的劳资纠纷。

(印：JAB 20/10)

The China Evening News dated Oct. 16:
LABOUR SITUATION IN THE SHANGHAI POWER CO.P.NY.
A fortnight has elapsed and the labour
trouble in the Shanghai Power Company remains
unsettled. Most of the Chinese staff members,
persuaded by the management have resumed work. Only
about 40 staff members are maintaining their original
attitude to act in concert with the 1,400 workers
who are on strike and have not been dissuaded by
the promises of the management.
It is reported that the Shanghai Power
Company Staff Members & Workers Mutual Benefit Society
and the 4th District Waterworks & Electricity Trade
Workers Union are about to issue a joint manifesto
re the dispute.
The "Central China Daily News" reports that
at 7 p.m. yesterday, the electric supply failed in
the vicinity of Hongkew Market near Fearon Road and
Hanbury Road. The citizens became alarmed and stores
closed their doors and suspended business. The
failure was only temporary however lasting until
7.45 p.m.
It is reported that the cause of the
failure was an explosion in the Transforming Room
of the old plant of the Shanghai Power Company.
As the workers of the plant were all on strike,
the repairs were delayed but were later completed
by foreign employees.
Chen Pao and other local newspapers (Oct. 17):
The Shanghai Power Company has bought
120 beds for the staff members who have resumed
work to enable them to lodge on the premises and
in addition to this, has ordered every day from a
certain restaurant 40 tables of food each costing
$3.50, for the employees in question.
Sou Jih-hsin (□□□) and Yih Kwei-ping
(□□□), members of the Staff Members "Go-slow"
Strike Committee and the secret inspectors of the
Committee named Chen Ching-loh (□□□), Tsi
Foong-kong (□□□), Mei Choh-beng (□□□),
Soo Shing-san (□□□); Zee Ching-sun (□□□),
Kwoh Pao-sun (□□□) and Wong Liang-yuen (□□□),
and about 290 others resumed work this morning.

10月16日的《中国晚报》（The China Evening News）：
上海电力公司的劳工局势
两周已过，上海电力公司的劳资纠纷仍未解决。大多数中方职员在管理层的劝说下已复工。只有约40名职员保持原有态度，与1,400名罢工工人采取一致行动，未被管理层的承诺所劝退。
据报道，上海电力公司职员与工人互益会和第四区水电业工会即将就此次纠纷发表联合宣言。
《华中日报》报道，昨晚7时，费伦路（Fearon Road）和汉伯里路（Hanbury Road）附近的虹口市场一带停电。市民感到恐慌，商店关门停业。然而停电只是暂时的，持续到晚上7时45分。
据报道，停电原因是上海电力公司旧厂变压室发生爆炸。由于该厂工人全部罢工，维修工作被延误，但后来由外籍员工完成。
《申报》及其他本地报纸（10月17日）：
上海电力公司为已复工的职员购买了120张床铺，以便他们在厂区内住宿，此外，还向某餐馆每日订购40桌饭菜，每桌费用为3.50元，供相关员工食用。
□□□（Sou Jih-hsin）和 □□□（Yih Kwei-ping），职员“怠工”罢工委员会成员，以及被点名担任委员会密查员的陈慶祿（□□□）、□□□（Tsi Foong-kong）、□□□（Mei Choh-beng）、苏兴山（Soo Shing-san (□□□)）；徐俊生（Zee Ching-sun (□□□)）、郭宝孙（Kwoh Pao-sun (□□□)）和黄良元（Wong Liang-yuen (□□□)）等约290人于今晨复工。

such as Mr. Wong Sieo Lai, chairman of the Shanghai
Chamber of Commerce, Mr. Yuan Li Tung and Mr. Lee
Sin Loh, Chinese councillors of the Shanghai Municipal
Council have submitted proposals to the company, the
company refused to accept them and maintained firm
attitude. The company also paid no heed to the
proposals of Mr. Jones, Secretary of your council
which followed the petition of the workers. The
workers were obliged to declare a "Go-slow" strike
as a protest to the company's actions. The strike
took place owing to the company declaring a lockout.
In accordance with the advice of this union the
distribution hands are still working and public order
has not been affected. We cannot guarantee that
distribution will be maintained. Therefore this union
held a conference with leaders of the society and
asked them to preserve peace and order. Up to the
present the company has no definite policy and has
done nothing except publish a letter containing
false statements. There can be no doubt that the
company intends to ignore the advice of this union.
As the council is responsible for maintaining peace in
the municipality you should give your whole attention
to the matter, and carefully examine the letter addressed
to the various bodies and the reply to the workers of
this union. This union has done its utmost to
persuade the workers to modify their demands, and
should the company refuse to accept these it is
evident that the company refused to consider public
right and municipal administration.

Your council for the sake of public
peace should advise the head office of the company
in America to change the present management, otherwise
besides ignoring the proposals of Mr. Jones, they
will also ignore the authority of the council.
We hope that the council will help this
union in settling this dispute, and await a reply
to this letter.

The China Times received two letters
on October 18 signed by Chen Ching-loh, Mei Choh-hang,
Tai Foong-kong, Soo Shing-san, Zee Ching-sun and
Kwoh Pao-sun, which read that they are greatly
surprised over the report published on October 17
because they have neither undertaken the posts of
secret inspectors of the Committee nor have they
taken an active part in the "go-slow" strike.

上海总工会致工部局函

鉴于上海电力公司罢工可能严重影响公众，本会已竭尽全力解决此次纠纷。尽管上海总商会主席黄晓籁先生、上海公共租界工部局华董袁履登先生和李生乐先生等政治组织代表已向该公司提交提案，但该公司拒绝接受，并持强硬态度。该公司亦未理会贵局秘书琼斯先生继工人请愿后提出的建议。工人们被迫宣布实行“怠工”罢工，以抗议公司的行为。此次罢工是由于公司宣布闭厂而引发的。根据本会的建议，配电人员仍在继续工作，公共秩序未受影响。我们无法保证供电能够维持。因此，本会与社会各界领袖举行会议，请求他们维护和平与秩序。截至目前，该公司尚无明确政策，除发表一封包含虚假陈述的信件外，未采取任何行动。毫无疑问，该公司意图无视本会的建议。由于工部局有责任维护本市治安，贵局应全力关注此事，并仔细审查致各团体的信函以及对本会工人的回复。本会已尽最大努力劝说工人修改其要求，如果公司拒绝接受这些要求，显然表明该公司不顾公义及市政管理。

为了公共安宁，贵局应建议该公司位于美国的总公司更换现任管理层，否则，他们不仅会无视琼斯先生的提议，还将无视工部局的权威。我们希望贵局协助本会解决此争端，并等候对此信的回复。

《字林西报》于10月18日收到两封署名陈庆禄、梅卓恒（音译）、戴奉康、苏兴山、徐俊生和郭宝生的信件，信中表示他们对10月17日刊登的报道深感惊讶，因为他们既未担任委员会秘密视察员的职务，也未积极参与“怠工”罢工。

Chen Pao of the 17th October, 1933

S.P.C. CHINESE STAFF RESUMING DUTY UNDER MANAGEMENT'S
INDUCEMENTS

The "go-slow" strike of the employees
engaged by the Shanghai Power Company has been in progress
for a fortnight and the dispute has not yet been settled.
As a result of the inducements held out by the management,
all the staff with the exception of about 30 members and
1400 workmen have resumed duty.
It will be recalled that as a protest against
the refusal of the management to pay superannuation funds,
the employees including staff members and workmen numbering
some 1750 started a "go-slow" strike from the 29th of last
month.
The movement is orderly. Although ostensibly
the attitude of the management seems to be adamant, yet
they secretly directed their senior Chinese staff members
to induce their fellow members to resume.
As a result of the inducement, about 30 staff
members who are not strong-minded returned to their duty
on the 14th followed by some 300 of their colleagues who,
wavering in their determination in consequence of the seces-
sion of the 30 members from the movement later succumbed
to the inducement of the management.
The authorities of the company seeing that
their staff members could be persuaded bought 120 canvas
beds for their accommodation in the night on the 5th floor
of the company's premises. In addition, the management
order every day 40 tables of food at $3.50 per table for
their staff.
As the staff members who returned to their
duty are thus able to carry on their work in comfortable
circumstances, Pu Jih Sun (蒲日森) and Yih Kwai Ping
(葉魁炳) members of the Staff Strike Committee, Chen Ching
Loh (陳慶祿), Tai Fung Kong (戴奉康), Mai Yu Fang (梅
玉鵬), Soo Hsing San (蘇興山), Zee Tsing Sung (徐俊生)
Kuo Pao Sung (郭寶生), Wong Liang Yun (王良雲),
secret inspectors of the Strike Committee and others totalling
280 all resumed duty this morning, leaving about 30 members
who continued to strike with the workers.
Although inducements have also been offered by
the management to about 1400 workers employed at the Old
and New Plants, they stand firm and express their determination
to continue the strike.
It is learned that a joint manifesto will be
issued by the Shanghai Power Company Employees Mutual Aid
Society and the Fourth District Water and Electricity Labour
Union.

1933年10月17日《申报》

上海电力公司华籍职员在管理层利诱下复工

上海电力公司雇员的“怠工”罢工已持续两周，纠纷尚未解决。由于管理层施加利诱，除约30名职员和1400名工人外，所有员工均已复工。

回想上月29日，为抗议管理层拒绝支付养老金，包括职员和工人在内的约1750名员工发起了“怠工”罢工。

此次运动秩序井然。虽然管理层的表面态度似乎坚定不移，但他们暗中指示高级华籍职员诱导同事复工。

由于受到利诱，约30名意志不坚定的职员于14日返回工作岗位，随后约有300名同事因这30人退出运动而决心动摇，最终也屈从于管理层的利诱。

公司当局见其职员可被说服，便于5日晚在公司大楼五楼购买了12张帆布床供其住宿。此外，管理层每天为其职员订购40桌饭菜，每桌3.50美元。

由于返岗职员能在舒适的环境下工作，职员罢工委员会委员蒲日森和葉魁炳，以及罢工委员会秘密视察员陈庆禄、戴奉康、梅玉鵬、蘇興山、徐俊生、郭寶生、王良雲等共计280人，均于今晨复工，仅剩约30名职员继续与工人一起罢工。

虽然管理层也向新旧厂房的约1400名工人提供利诱，但他们立场坚定，表示决心继续罢工。

据悉，上海电力公司职工互助会和第四区水电工会将联合发表宣言。

Age: between 28 and 31 years, Height: 5' 6",

foreign clothes, horned rimmed spectacles and walks with
a slight stoop. He is reported to be heavily in debt
and made but few friends in the office where he was
employed. He has only shown friendliness to one of his
fellow employees this being one named Soo Shing San (蘇興山),

REPORT
Date October 19, 1933.
File No......

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company -- Situation.

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by [签名] C.S.T.

The situation at the various depots of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
It is learned that in addition to the 240 casual
Russian labourers taken on since the commencement of the
present impasse, the Company have found it necessary to
employ some 20 Anglo-Saxons (British-American, etc.)
for work in dynamo rooms, etc.
Mr. Hopkins pointed out during a recent
interview that more of the destitute Western Europeans
and Americans would have been taken on but for the
resulting loss of prestige. It might be explained
that the Riverside Power Station in all main essential's is
automatic, thus there is only room for a very limited
number of technical men. The sections where men are
urgently needed in times such as the present are on
boiler-cleaning, ash-dumping, coal-heaving, etc. occupations
only taken up by the lowest grade coolie. Mr. Hopkins
expressed the opinion that it was not in the best interests
of the community to allow men to degrade themselves for
a few extra dollars per month.

[签名]
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Commr. of Police.

Date October 18, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [签名]

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.
The deputation of idle workmen who approached
one of the Foreign employees of the Company on October 17,
(Vide my report dated 17/10/33), expressed the opinion that
it would be dangerous for them to resume work at present.
In connection with the reference to the assault
on one Poh Ih Sing (卜華新) (Vide my report dated October
17, 1933), enquiries made by D.S.I. Pan Lien Pih at the
Lester Hospital, Shantung Road at noon, October 17, revealed
that one named Poh Ih-sing was admitted to the Hospital on
the evening of October 16, but left at 11.45 a.m. October 17.
At the time of the visit, one of Poh's friend was present,
but when questioned as to Poh's present whereabouts refused
to disclose it. This person was requested to get Poh to
ring up Police Headquarters at 2.30 p.m. October 17.
At the time mentioned Poh Ih-sing rang up and made
the following statement :-
"At 1.30 p.m. October 15, two Chinese suspected of
being Shanghai Power Company workers strike-pickets entered my
room and then admitted three others. The intruders assaulted
me with hands and feet. One of them knocked my head against
a cement pillar causing a deep cut. My assailants remained
in my room some fifteen minutes and before departure threatened
that they would take my life during the night. Although I
do not know their names I think I can identify them should
I meet them. Half an hour after the departure of the
intruders, the Chinese Police came to the scene and made
enquiries. I remained at home till 10 a.m. October 16

（左侧手写批注：The assault occurred in Nantao 9/18）

由 D.S.I. Golder 撰写 转呈 [签名]

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。
10月17日接近该公司一名外籍雇员的那群 idle workmen（闲置工人/失业工人）代表团（参见我1933年10月17日的报告），表示认为目前复工对他们来说是危险的。
关于袭击卜華新 (Poh Ih Sing) 一事（参见我1933年10月17日的报告），D.S.I. Pan Lien Pih 于10月17日中午在山东路的莱斯特医院进行的查询显示，一名名为 Poh Ih-sing 的人于10月16日晚入院，但于10月17日上午11时45分离开。探访时，卜的一位朋友在场，但当被问及卜目前的下落时，拒绝透露。此人被要求让卜在10月17日下午2时30分致电警察总局。
在上述时间，卜華新打来电话并作了如下陈述：
“10月15日下午1时30分，两名疑似为上海电力公司罢工纠察队的华人进入我的房间，随后又放进另外三人。闯入者对我拳打脚踢。其中一人将我的头撞向水泥柱，造成一道深伤口。袭击者在我的房间里停留了约十五分钟，离开前威胁说要在夜间取我性命。虽然我不知道他们的名字，但如果再见到他们，我想我能认出他们。闯入者离开半小时后，华警来到现场进行调查。我一直待在家里直到10月16日上午10时

（左侧手写批注：袭击发生在南市 9/18）

Efforts have been made to interview Poh Ih-sing, but

A visit was paid by D.S.I. Pan to No.40 Dah Vuh Chong
Ka, outside the Great South Gate, on October 17 and it was
discovered that the families of both Poh Ih-sing and Poh
Zuh-sing (卜日新) were absent. Enquiries of a sub-tenant
of the house revealed that Poh Zuh-sing and his family
went away on October 14, while his brother Poh Ih-sing's
family left on October 16. According to the informant,
at 1.40 p.m. October 15 several Chinese of the labourer
type called at the above address and demanded to see Poh
Zuh-sing. Dissatisfied with the reply of the inmates
regarding Poh Zuh-sing's absence, the intruders forced their
way into a room where Poh Ih-sing was resting and assaulted
him. They remained inside for about twenty minutes and
before leaving the premises threatened to murder their
victim during the night. After their departure, the
sub-tenants communicated with the Chinese Police of the
neighbourhood.

随后我被送往圣卢克医院，再次被拒绝提供床位。最终，在公司一名外籍雇员的协助下，我被收入华人莱斯特医院并在那里过夜。我于10月17日上午11时45分离开医院，并将有关我伤情的医疗证明交给了上海电力公司的 Perrin 先生。

警方曾试图面见卜華新，但他拒绝透露目前的住址。

D.S.I. Pan 于10月17日前往大南门外大华钟家40号进行走访，发现卜華新和卜日新 (Poh Zuh-sing) 两家均不在家。对该房屋转租客的查询显示，卜日新及其家人于10月14日离开，而其兄卜華新的家人则于10月16日离开。据线人称，10月15日下午1时40分，几名苦力模样的华人来到上述地址，要求见卜日新。因对屋内人员关于卜日新不在家的答复不满，闯入者强行进入卜華新正在休息的房间并对其实施殴打。他们在屋内停留了约二十分钟，离开 premises（场所/寓所）前威胁要在夜间杀害受害者。他们离开后，转租客联系了附近的华警。

Date October 18, 1933

Subject (in full) Letter addressed to Mr Springfield by S.P.C. workers.

Made by. D.S. Jones Forwarded by. D.S.O. Everest.

With reference to the allegation contained in the
attached letter drawn up in English addressed to Mr L.O.
Springfield and signed "By the Chinese Staff Association of the
Shanghai Power Company" that certain strike leaders, who at the
same time are communists, are at present hiding in the offices
of the Shanghai Power Company, I have to state that there is no
truth in this.

When interviewed and shown the letter Mr Hill, General-
Manager of the S.P.C., informed me that he had received letters
containing similar allegations. He thought so little of them
that he threw them in the waste-paper basket.

The first four persons mentioned in the letter appear to
be identical with committee members of the S.P.C. Clerical
Assistants Strike Committee which was formed on October 11, but
one cannot be certain of this as the romanization of the names
is different and the corresponding Chinese characters are not
given in the letter.

It is not known who Woo Burn Kor is.

Officer i/c Special Branch
D.S. Jones
D.S.

由 D.S. Jones 撰写 转呈 D.S.O. Everest。

关于附函中提出的指控，该信以英文写成，致 L.O. Springfield 先生，并由“上海电力公司华人职员协会”签署，称某些同时也是共产党员的罢工领袖目前藏匿在上海电力公司的办公室内，我必须声明这并非事实。

当出示该信并进行面谈时，上海电力公司总经理 Hill 先生告诉我，他收到过包含类似指控的信件。他对此不屑一顾，将其扔进了废纸篓。

信中提到的前四人似乎与10月11日成立的上海电力公司职员助理罢工委员会的委员相同，但由于姓名的罗马拼音不同，且信中未给出对应的汉字，因此无法确定这一点。

无人知晓 Woo Burn Kor 是谁。

Date October 17, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Strike situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [签名]

At 10.30 a.m. October 17, some 40 foremen and
50 workers of the Shanghai Power Company assembled in the
office of the General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City,
when Pao Teh-foh (包德福), member of the Strike Committee
of the 4th District Water & Electricity Workers' Union,
expressed the hope that all strikers would persist in the
movement to the bitter end and would not allow themselves
to be misled by propaganda being circulated by reactionary
elements. Later Chu Hsueh-fan (朱学范), committee
member of the General Labour Union, took the stand and
praised the undaunted spirit of the workers of the Shanghai
Power Company in declaring and maintaining the strike
which clearly manifested the united strength of local
labour. The fact that up to the present no delegates
had been sent to approach the Management for negotiation
did not mean that the leaders of the movement were at
their wits end. They were, he stated, waiting for the
Management to come forward with suggestions for a
settlement. When they sue for mediation we shall know
that victory is ours. The last speaker was Nyi Wen-fu
(倪文富), another member of the Strike Committee, who
denounced the clerical staff for their resumption of work
and urged all strikers not to follow their cowardly example.
He intimated that Poh Zuh-sing's brother who was a strike
breaker had been assaulted at his home, and in conclusion
expressed a hope that the audience would take this assault
as a warning. The meeting concluded at 11.15 a.m.
(The foregoing information was obtained by
Agent No.59).

制作人：特务科督察长 Golder 转呈人：[签名]

10月17日上午10时30分，约40名工头和50名上海电力公司工人聚集在位于市区福州路117号的总工会办事处。第四区水电工会罢工委员会委员包德福（Pao Teh-foh）表示，希望所有罢工者坚持运动到底，不要被反动分子散布的宣传所误导。随后，总工会委员朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan）发言，赞扬上海电力公司工人在宣布并维持罢工过程中表现出的大无畏精神，这清楚地表明了本地劳工的团结力量。他指出，迄今为止未派代表与管理层进行谈判，并不意味着运动领导人已束手无策。他说，他们正在等待管理层提出解决建议。一旦对方寻求调解，我们就知道胜利属于我们。最后一位发言者是罢工委员会的另一名成员倪文富（Nyi Wen-fu），他谴责职员复工的行为，并敦促所有罢工者不要效仿这种懦弱的榜样。他暗示，浦实新（Poh Zuh-sing）的兄弟作为一名破坏罢工者，在其家中遭到袭击，最后他希望听众将此次袭击视为警告。会议于上午11时15分结束。

APPENDIX

Free Translation of Handbill Denouncing the 4th District
Water & Electricity Workers' Union which was found in
Eastern District on October 14

The nine articles which the 4th District Water and
Electricity Workers' Union requires workers of the Shanghai
Power Company to observe during the present strike are as
follows:-
1. That 'tai-kung' Strike Committee shall direct the movement.
2. Workers of the Old and New Stations of the Company are
required implicitly to obey the order and the Direction
of the Committee.
3. Workers are not allowed to undertake any illegal activity
but should be peaceful and orderly.
4. Fabricating rumours is prohibited.
5. Workers shall quietly await a settlement of the dispute and
should avoid agitating or becoming alarmed.
6. Loitering in front of the stations is not permitted.
7. Workers requiring information should attend places designated.
8. Workers who fail to observe the aforementioned rules will be
dealt with as if they were strike-breakers.
9. Workers who consent to be the running dogs of the Company
or to act as strike-breakers will be severely dealt with.
The foregoing rules contain many defects which we wish to
point out to our colleagues with a view to having the situation
remedied.
1. The rules call for implicit obedience. Why should this be so?
Why should the workers be bound down by rules which have
not been approved or discussed at a general meeting of the
workers' representatives, and why should workers who fail
to comply with such rules be liable to be punished?.
2. The first article of the Rules mentions that the 'Tai-Kung'
Strike Committee has control of the strike but what is the
source of the authority it exercises? It may have been
authorized by the local or the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai to control the strike but are the workers prepared
to recognize these bodies as the superior organs. We
suggest that a general meeting be convened to re-organize
the Committee.
3. The workers will not support the present Strike Committee
as it was formed by a group of persons who do not represent
them.
The second article of the Rules is ridiculous. Are the workers
going to obey the Strike Committee if it agrees to settle the
dispute without obtaining concessions? Are the workers going to
allow matters to drift for one or two months without any settlement being reached.
4. The oppression brought to bear upon the workers by the
American imperialists is intolerable. We must put forward
our demands. Our movement is quite reasonable and legal.
The Tai-Kung Strike Committee prevents the workers from
taking reprisals against the Management although they have
done nothing to indicate that they will resort to any measures
which are not legal. The Company is now employing "White"
Russians to take the places of the Chinese workers although
this action is absolutely illegal.
5. What do the workers know about rumours? The Committee
directs the strike, and forbids the workers to speak at
meetings. The workers cannot foresee when the dispute
will come to an end and consequently are opposed
to the Committee. The workers do not fabricate rumours.
6. The advice that the workers should wait patiently for a
settlement of the strike means that they must confine
themselves in their homes and do nothing. The workers
of the San Yeu Factory have waited for more than a year,
but their patience has been rewarded by bitter suffering.

10月14日在东区发现的谴责第四区水电工会的传单的意译

第四区水电工会要求上海电力公司工人在当前罢工期间遵守的九条规定如下：-
1. “大公”罢工委员会应指导运动。
2. 公司老站和新站的工人必须绝对服从委员会的命令和指导。
3. 不允许工人从事任何非法活动，而应保持和平有序。
4. 禁止制造谣言。
5. 工人应静待纠纷解决，避免煽动或惊慌。
6. 不允许在电站前逗留。
7. 需要信息的工人应前往指定地点。
8. 不遵守上述规定的工人将按破坏罢工者论处。
9. 同意充当公司走狗或充当破坏罢工者的工人将受到严厉处置。
上述规则存在许多缺陷，我们希望向同事们指出，以便纠正局势。
1. 规则要求绝对服从。为什么要这样？为什么工人要受限于未经工人代表全体会议批准或讨论的规则，以及为什么不遵守这些规则的工人要受到惩罚？
2. 规则第一条提到“大公”罢工委员会控制罢工，但其行使权力的来源是什么？它可能已被地方当局或大上海市政府授权控制罢工，但工人们是否准备承认这些机构为上级机关？我们建议召开全体会议重组委员会。
3. 工人们不会支持目前的罢工委员会，因为它是由一群不代表他们的人组成的。
规则的第二条是荒谬的。如果罢工委员会同意在不获得让步的情况下解决纠纷，工人们会服从吗？工人们会让事情拖延一两个月而没有达成任何解决方案吗？
4. 美国帝国主义者对工人施加的压迫是不可容忍的。我们必须提出要求。我们的运动是完全合理和合法的。尽管“大公”罢工委员会没有采取任何表明他们将诉诸非法措施的行动，但它阻止工人对管理层进行报复。公司现在雇用“白”俄取代中国工人，尽管这一行动是绝对非法的。
5. 工人对谣言了解多少？委员会指导罢工，并禁止工人在会议上发言。工人无法预见纠纷何时结束，因此反对委员会。工人并没有制造谣言。
6. 建议工人耐心等待罢工解决，意味着他们必须把自己关在家里，无所事事。三友实业社的工人已经等待了一年多，但他们的耐心换来的是痛苦的折磨。

page_data.en:
APPENDIX

(2)

To wait patiently is to wait for death. The workers should
organize picketing groups to assault the 'white' Russians
who robbed them of their jobs.
7. The Strike Committee prohibits workers from loitering near the
gates of the Company's Stations. They say they fear the workers
will enter the stations and resume work, but really they are
afraid that the workers will assault the "white" Russians and
call the shift-men to join the strike. A course of action which
the Committee forbids.
8. With regard to the article reading "Workers should apply to the
places designated by the Strike Committee for information",
the Committee should submit reports on happenings at meetings
to the workers so that the latter may decide for themselves
the course of action to be adopted.
9. The workers are of opinion that compromising with the capitalists
means postponement of a settlement of the dispute.
The workers are advised to refrain from adopting measures to
drive away the "White" Russians and are told that the station
shift men should not join the movement. The people who tell the
workers to resume without obtaining satisfaction are the real
strike-breakers.
It is a joke to denounce as strike-breakers workers who fail to
observe the Rules of the Strike Committee as the workers did not
approve of these rules.
10. The capitalists reject the workers demands because they consider
the five hundred Russians they have employed make them independent
of the Chinese workers, and because they know that the Union has
forbidden the shift-men to join the strike.
In the past ten days the capitalists have had plenty of time to
train the Russians. Who are the real strike-breakers and how
are they to be dealt with?
11. The workers advise adoption of the following methods:
a) That a general meeting be held to elect a strike committee
of one or two hundred persons.
b) That armed picketing groups consisting of a total strength
of six or eight hundred people be organized to drive
the "White" Russians from the Power Stations.
c) That the shift men be persuaded to declared a strike and that
the supply of electricity to the public be suspended.
d) That the workers insist that their demands be accepted in
full before they agree to go back.

Note by Translator: This handbill seems to emanate from the
Chinese Communist Party.
page_data.zh:
附录

(2)

耐心等待就是等待死亡。工人应该组织纠察队去袭击抢走他们工作的“白”俄。
7. 罢工委员会禁止工人在公司电站大门附近逗留。他们说担心工人进入电站复工，但实际上他们是担心工人袭击“白”俄并号召轮班工人加入罢工。这是委员会禁止的行动方针。
8. 关于“工人应向罢工委员会指定的地点申请信息”这一条，委员会应在会议上向工人提交事件报告，以便后者自行决定要采取的行动方针。
9. 工人认为，与资本家妥协意味着推迟纠纷的解决。
有人劝告工人不要采取驱逐“白”俄的措施，并告知电站轮班工人不应加入运动。那些告诉工人在未获得满意结果前就复工的人才是真正的破坏罢工者。
将不遵守罢工委员会规则的工人斥为破坏罢工者是个笑话，因为工人并未批准这些规则。
10. 资本家拒绝工人的要求，因为他们认为雇用的五百名俄国人使他们不再依赖中国工人，并且他们知道工会已禁止轮班工人加入罢工。
在过去十天里，资本家有充足的时间训练俄国人。谁才是真正的破坏罢工者，以及如何处置他们？
11. 工人建议采取以下方法：
a) 举行全体会议，选举一个由一两百人组成的罢工委员会。
b) 组织总人数为六百至八百人的武装纠察队，将“白”俄赶出电站。
c) 说服轮班工人宣布罢工，并停止向公众供电。
d) 工人坚持在完全接受其要求之前，不同意回去工作。

译者注：这份传单似乎出自中国共产党。

Date October 17, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation - assault
on loyal worker.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by C.S.T. McEwen

The situation in the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning,
October 17, the number of men affected remaining at 1516.
During the forenoon of Saturday, October 14,
some 10 strikers of the Shanghai Power Company proceeded to
No.40 Dah Veh Tsang Ka, Great South Gate, Nantao, the home
of Y.S. Pu (浦華新) and Pu King Foo ( ), brothers,
and both loyal employees of the Shanghai Power Company.
One of the strikers gained admittance to the house and
asked for Pu King Foo, but as he was not in, his brother,
Y. S. Pu came from his room to see what the caller wanted.
His appearance was the signal for those waiting outside to
rush inside, commence to beat him and break up the household
furniture. After the strikers had knocked Pu insensible
and smashed everything within sight, they decamped. Pu was
taken to a doctor who found him to be suffering from
contused wounds on the head, face and body; the last of
which are still causing considerable pain. Pu will be
moved from the house of a friend where he has been staying
since Saturday, to St. Lukes Hospital, where his expenses
will be borne by the Company.
The St. Lukes Hospital will be visited during the
course of the day with a view to obtaining a statement from
the injured man.

D. S. I.
(印：J. Golder 17 Oct 1933)
Officer i/c Special Branch.

制作人：特务科督察长 Golder 转呈人：C.S.T. McEwen

今天早晨，10月17日，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变，受影响人数仍为1516人。
在10月14日星期六上午，约10名上海电力公司罢工者前往南市大南门大华张卡40号（No.40 Dah Veh Tsang Ka, Great South Gate, Nantao），即浦华新（Y.S. Pu）和浦金福（Pu King Foo）（ ）兄弟的住所，两人均为上海电力公司的忠诚员工。其中一名罢工者获准进入屋内，寻找浦金福，但他不在家，他的兄弟浦华新从房间里出来查看来访者的意图。他的出现是外面等待的人冲进来的信号，他们开始殴打他并打碎家具。罢工者在将浦打昏并砸碎视线内的一切物品后逃跑了。浦被送往医生处，医生发现他头部、面部和身体有挫伤；最后的伤势至今仍引起剧烈疼痛。浦将从他自星期六以来一直居住的朋友家搬往圣路加医院（St. Lukes Hospital），其费用将由公司承担。
当天晚些时候将访问圣路加医院，以获取受伤男子的陈述。

Date October 15. 19 33.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company- Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by [Signature]

The situation in the various departments
of the Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning.

With regard to the news item appearing in
the October 14, issue of the China Times and other papers
relative to the alleged stoning of one Chow Shao-kwei (周紹奎)
a staff-employee of the Shanghai Power Company, who it is
stated proceeded to the General Labour Union, Foh Yeu Road,
Nantao, on October 13 when he was stoned by a number of strike
pickets. Enquiries show that no such incident occured; Chow
presented himself at the General Labour Union with the intention
of attending a meeting but was refused admittance until he
had proved to the attendance that he was not a strike-breaker.

Letters continue to be addressed to the
S.M.C by public bodies and social organisations requesting an
early settlement of the Shanghai Power Company labour dispute.
Sentiment is invariably on the side of the strikers which
would indicate that the letters have been written at their
behest.

It has been learned from a confidential
source that within the next few days the Company will make
public its intention to permit the resumption of work of those
employees and workers who were forced to leave their duty
owing to intimidation. Pay will commence from the date of
resumption whilst the Company intends to reserve to itself,
the right to refuse the services of any person who took an
active part in the organisation of the strike or the subse-
quent intimidation of the Company's employees and workers.

（左侧手写批注：This also indicates that the Chinese Authorities, which control these so-called public bodies, are on the side of the strikers. JG）

今晨，上海电力公司各部门的局势保持不变。

关于10月14日《字林西报》（China Times）及其他报纸上刊登的一则新闻，称上海电力公司职员周绍奎（Chow Shao-kwei）于10月13日前往南市福佑路总工会时，被多名罢工纠察队投石袭击。经查，并未发生此类事件；周绍奎前往总工会意图参加会议，但在向在场人员证明其并非破坏罢工者之前，被拒绝入内。

公共团体和社会组织继续致函工部局，要求尽早解决上海电力公司劳资纠纷。舆论 invariably 站在罢工者一边，这表明这些信件是在他们的授意下撰写的。

据机密消息来源获悉，该公司将在未来几天内公开宣布，允许那些因受到恐吓而被迫离职的雇员和工人复工。工资将从复工之日起计算，同时公司打算保留拒绝任何积极参与组织罢工或随后恐吓公司雇员和工人的人员服务的权利。

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by C.S.I. J. S. Prince

The situation/the various departments of the
Shanghai Power Company remained practically unchanged at 4 p.m.
October 13. The Management informed me on October 13, that a
number of the head-office staff had been threatened by the
strikers, but that no serious incident had so far taken place.
From enquiries made in connection with the intimidation of
loyal workers it is clear that the greater part of the trouble
is confined to the bus and tram-car routes from the Chinese
City and Nantao. To overcome this phase of the disturbance
the Company have arranged for about one hundred of the clerks
to sleep on the head-office premises until matters assume
normal proportions.

Efforts on the part of the local Tangpu and
General Labour Union are still being made to interest influential
Chinese in the early settlement of the dispute, sofar, however,
their efforts have met with little success.

In connection with the dismissal of G.W.C. 6
Ying Ping-yoong ( 邱炳榮 ) who was found asleep in the
Chinese lavatory at Riverside Power Station . It has been
learned that this man was actually paid a retiring gratuity
of $46.19 in addition to the wages due to him .

The following public bodies have addressed
letters to the Shanghai Municipal Council relative to the
existing dispute and advising that an early settlement be
made so that the public shall suffer no inconvenience:-
(1) The Chinese Ratepayers Association.
(2) Chekiang fellow-countrymens Association.
(3) The 17th Branch of the Citizens Federation.

截至10月13日下午4时，上海电力公司各部门的局势实际上未发生变化。管理层于10月13日告知我，部分总部职员受到罢工者的威胁，但迄今未发生严重事件。就恐吓忠诚工人一事进行的查询表明，大部分骚乱局限于从华界和南市出发的公共汽车和有轨电车路线。为了克服这一阶段的动荡，公司已安排约一百名职员在总部办公场所过夜，直到事态恢复正常。

关于解雇 G.W.C. 6 级员工邱炳榮（Ying Ping-yoong）一事，此人被发现睡在杨树浦发电厂的中文厕所里。据悉，除了应付给他的工资外，此人实际还获得了一笔46.19美元的退休金。

The situation in the various departments of
the Shanghai Power Company remains generally unchanged to-day.
There has been a slight increase in the number of men affected
during the last two days, this is due to the absence of about
ten percent of the clerical staff, who, led by one Woo Tsu Bei
( 吴祖培 ), and under pressure from the strikers, attempted
to involve the whole of the office staff some 450 men. It is
apparent that the clerks do not wish to strike as many of the
men who attended the meeting held in the Chinese City on
October 11 have since returned to work.

The Management have informed those clerks who
wish to remain at work, but who are living in Chinese Territory,
that the Company will bear the cost of the removal of themselves
and families to localities where intimidation can be least
expected and that certain provision will be made for any increase
in the cost of living occasioned by such removals.

A notice was issued by the Management to all
departments of the head-office on October 11 setting forth that
all those office employees whose names appear on the Clerical Staff 'Strike Committee'
were dismissed from that date and that those who absented them-
-selves to attend the meeting on October 11, but who returned to
work the same day, must make a full explanation of their action, in
writing, to the Management, who will consider whether or not
their services are to be terminated.

Information has come to hand that certain
members of the local Tangpu and the General Labour Union, namely,
Loh Ching Dze ( 陸京士 ) and Chu Hsueh-fan ( 朱學範 )
have made tentative attempts to get certain influential
people in the Settlement interested in the settlement of the

主题（全称）上海电力公司——局势

撰写人：副督察长 Golder。转呈人：[签名]

今天，上海电力公司各部门的局势大体保持不变。在过去两天里，受影响的人数略有增加，这是由于约百分之十的职员缺席所致，他们在吴祖培（Woo Tsu Bei）的带领下，并在罢工者的压力下，试图牵连整个办公室职员，共计约450人。显然，职员们并不希望罢工，因为许多参加10月11日在华界举行的会议的人此后已返回工作岗位。

管理层已告知那些希望继续工作但居住在中国境内的职员，公司将承担他们及其家属搬迁至恐吓可能性最小地区的费用，并将对此类搬迁引起的生活成本增加提供一定的补偿。

管理层于10月11日向总部各部门发布通知，阐明所有名字出现在“职员罢工委员会”上的办公室雇员自即日起被解雇，而那些缺席参加10月11日会议但同日返回工作岗位的人，必须向管理层书面充分解释其行为，管理层将考虑是否终止其服务。

有消息传来，当地唐浦（Tangpu）工会和总工会的某些成员，即陆京士（Loh Ching Dze）和朱学范（Chu Hsueh-fan），已初步尝试让租界内的某些有影响力的人士关注纠纷的解决。

（左侧批注：信息收录于 1933年10月14日 R. [签名]）

existing dispute. No details of the manner of the proposed
settlement have come to hand, but it is generally believed that the
terms insisted upon are not acceptable to the Management.

From a careful survey of the events leading up
to the present impasse it becomes clear that the strikers are
lacking a case in their dispute with the Management. They are
taking the side of men who do not deserve consideration at the
hands of the fellows, which fact has been admitted by the
Mayor of Greater Shanghai and other responsible Chinese
officials who have interviewed both the workers representatives
and the Management.

It might be pointed out that about the time
the management of the Electricity Department passed into the
hands of the Company, a certain amount of expansion work was
in progress. The work thus undertaken has gradually been
completed and the men employed on it released; this giving rise
to the claim of the workers that the Management have ruthlessly
reduced staff. It is true that the Management have reduced
staff in certain directions ,but there is no proof that this
has been done indiscriminately or without due consideration
for the men affected.

In connection with the pay etc., of the lower
grade employees of the Shanghai Power Company, enquiries at
Riverside Power Station show that they are paid as well and in
many cases better than elsewhere in Shanghai and that the
provisions made for their eventual retirement are carefully
looked after so long as the men do their work properly.

仔细审视导致目前僵局的各项事件后可以清楚地看到，罢工者在与管理层的纠纷中缺乏正当理由。他们站在那些不值得同胞同情的人一边，这一事实已得到大上海市市长及其他负责的中国官员的承认，这些官员曾会见工人代表和管理层。

需要指出的是，大约在电气处管理权移交给公司之时，正在进行一定规模的扩建工程。由此承担的工作已逐渐完成，受雇于此的工人已被遣散；这引发了工人声称管理层无情裁减人员的说法。诚然，管理层在某些方面确实减少了人员，但没有证据表明这是 indiscriminately 进行的或未适当考虑受影响工人的利益。

关于上海电力公司低级员工的薪资等问题，对杨树浦发电厂的查询显示，他们的待遇至少与上海其他地方一样好，甚至在许多情况下更好；只要工人们正常工作，为他们最终退休所做的安排也会得到妥善照顾。

Wu Tso Bei (吴祖培)

that the venue of the meeting, which, according to the
original plan, should have been held on the premises

of foreign members of the staff of the Company. He
also pointed out that a considerable amount of information
had leaked out into the possession of the management as
a result of the activities of spies and running dogs.

employees of the same concern should assist one another
but assistance could be rendered in many ways other than

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation - Clerical Staff at
Head Office hold meeting

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by C.S.T. Jow Prince

The situation at Riverside Power Station and the
various depots of the Company remains unchanged this morning,
thus the total number of men affected is 1496.

At about 5 p.m. October 9 Chu Hsueh-fan (朱學範),
committee member of the General Labour Union called on Hsu
Sing-loh (徐新六), General Manager of the National Commercial
Bank, No. 78 Peking Road, and requested him to mediate in the
dispute under report, on behalf of the workers. When
questioned as to the grounds for the request Chu Hsueh-fan
stated that the time had come for the matter to be settled
and that the workers were willing to resume on condition
that the following grants were made:-
(1) That all employees should be paid three months wages
should they leave the company after one year's service.
(2) That the five percent retiring gratuity to all workers
leaving the Company's employ be paid.
(3) That written regulations be posted in the various workshops
so that the workers may know the conditions under which
they are employed.
(4) That the four men dismissed in June and the 3 let out in
September be reinstated.
(5) That full pay be issued to all workers for the period of
the strike.

Mr. Hsu Sing-loh informed the caller that he had already been
in touch with the Company on the subject of settlement and
was of the opinion that the demands made by the workers
would not be met. He then telephoned to Mr. Hopkins,
President of the Shanghai Power Company and asked his opinion
on the matter of mediation. Mr. Hopkins stated that he was

主题（全称）：上海电力公司——局势——总公司职员举行会议

由特别巡捕戈尔德（Golder）呈报，经警司周·普林斯（Jow Prince）转呈

今晨，江边发电站及公司各分站的情况保持不变，因此受影响总人数为1496人。

10月9日下午5时许，总工会委员朱学范拜访了位于北京路78号的国货银行总经理徐新六，请求他代表工人调解本报告所述纠纷。当被问及提出此请求的理由时，朱学范表示，现在是解决此事的时候了，如果满足以下津贴条件，工人愿意复工：
(1) 凡在公司服务满一年后离职的所有雇员，应支付三个月工资。
(2) 向所有离开公司雇佣关系的工人支付百分之五的退职金。
(3) 在各车间张贴书面规章，以便工人了解其受雇条件。
(4) 恢复6月被解雇的四人和9月被解雇的三人的职务。
(5) 罢工期间向所有工人发放全额工资。

徐新六先生告知来访者，他就解决此事已与该公司取得联系，并认为工人提出的要求不会得到满足。随后他致电上海电力公司总裁霍普金斯先生，征求他对调解事宜的意见。霍普金斯先生表示，他

The situation at Riverside Power Station and the
various Depots of the Company remains generally unchanged
this morning with the exception of five of the clerical
staff, who, it is believed have failed to report for work
owing to intimidation. The number affected including
the five above mentioned is 1496.

Intimidation of the Company's loyal employees
took a serious turn yesterday. Sze Kiu Yuen (史久運),
a senior employee at the head office of the Company and
residing at 30 Koo Yoh Dong Ka, City, was at 8.50 p.m.
October 8 the victim of an attempted bombing. Enquiries
show that at the above time, 3 men, all dressed in blue
short jackets and pants, and who are suspected of being
S.P.C. employees, visited Sze's house, broke one of the
down stairs windows and threw in a loaded hand grenade
of the Chinese military type, which fortunately, failed
to explode. The crime was discovered by Sze's wife
who reported the matter to the nearest station of the
Public Safety Bureau.

Although the crime was committed in Chinese
controlled territory, this office is undertaking discreet
enquiries owing to its suspected connection with the labour
dispute under report.

In addition to the foregoing case numerous members
of the Company's employees have received veiled threats
of punishment should they continue to serve the Company.
30 meter-readers classified under "clerks" have informed the
Company that they will be unable to carry on unless
afforded some protection. In this connection Mr. Heald,

Extract from Report dated October 6, 1933 by
D.S.I. Golder of Special Branch

Shanghai Power Co. - Alleged abduction of workmen

During an interview with Mr. Heald on the
afternoon of October 5, he informed me that 2 workmen
namely. F.E.11 Woo Ah Kung (吴阿根) of No.31 Hwa Shing
Li, Jukong Road and F.E.23 Wong Yeu San (王友山) of
No.653 Point Road had been abducted by members of the
strikers whilst working near the Haig Court on Avenue
Haig sometime on October 4, and 5. The Senior Detective,
Bubblingwell was informed of the incident at 4 p.m.
October 5. Enquiries made by representatives of
Section I revealed that the two men together with
another workman named Yui Kong-yee (俞康義) were
caught on Yangtsepoo Road on the afternoon of October 4
by a number of strike pickets. They were first taken
to a photograph studio where they were photographed
and thence to the offices of the Union, where, it is
reported, they were subjected to assault and later
released. Efforts to locate the men at the addresses
supplied by the Company have so far prove futile.
There is every possibility that they have changed their
address without notifying their employers. In view
of the difficulty of locating the men in question,
efforts will be made to locate them through the company's
employees.

Date October 8, 1933.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Situation - Handbills
issued - Meetings of Union.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by C.S.I. J. Prince

The situation at Riverside Power Station and the
various depots of the Company remains unchanged this morning,
thus some 1491 men are still affected.

To date the Company have taken 150 temporary Russian
workmen into their employ. In connection with these men,
it has been rumoured, that they intend to ask for short term
contracts should the 320 Chinese shift men join the strike
of the workshop workers.

The matter was brought to the notice of Mr. Heald,
General Manager of the Company, who stated that if there
should be sufficient indication that the shift men will walk
out, he intends to inform the Russians that they will be
given employment for a reasonable period, even beyond the
bounds of actual necessity, and that those who make themselves
particularly useful to the Company will be given more or less
permanent employment.

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company Situation - Intimidation by Strikes

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by C.S.I. J.W. Prince

The situation at Riverside Power Station and the various
Depots of the company remains unchanged to-day thus the total
number of workers affected is 1491.

At 2.15 p.m. October 6, Mr. Ewart, Consumers Engineer,
S'hai Power Co. informed me that one of their workmen, P.I. 11
Tong King Ziang ( ), an outside-linesman, had been taken
by certain members of the strikers from Haining Road near North
Shanse Road to the Headquarters of the Union, No. 15 Shou Ying
Fang, Tiendong Road, Chapei. I reported the matter to West
Hongkew Station and requested the P.S.B. be informed through
C.A. Loh Sih Kya. Inquiries at the scene of the incident re-
vealed that P.I. 11 Tong King Ziang resides at No. P.D. 3 Lane
774 Haining Road. Yesterday he went to that address for food
and on leaving at about 12.30 p.m. was accosted by two of six
men (Shanghai Power Co. strikers) who advised him to accompany
them to Chapei. Tong proceeded with them and was taken to their
Union Headquarters, 15 Shou Ying Fang, Tiendong Road, Chapei.
There he was threatened with various kinds of punishment if
he continued to work and was then released. Detectives from
West Hongkew and I, prior to the discovery that the man had
been released, proceeded to the 5th District, 3 Section Station.
We saw the P.S.B. at Tiendong Road, where after being kept waiting
35 minutes whilst a detective went to the Union Headquarters
ostensibly to 'look see', but obviously to warn the occupants
of 15 Shou Ying Fang that the Settlement Police were coming,
we visited the Union offices. The man in search of whom we
had gone to Chapei was not in evidence, but the following persons
were present :-

今日江边发电站及该公司各分站的局势保持不变，因此受影响的工人总数为1491人。

10月6日下午2时15分，上海电力公司用户工程师 Ewart 先生告知我，该公司一名外线电工，警员编号11 Tong King Ziang (音译)，被几名罢工者从北山西路附近的海宁路带至闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的工会总部。我将此事报告给西虹口巡捕房，并要求通过华探长罗思嘉（Loh Sih Kya）通知中国警察局。在现场进行的调查显示，警员编号11 Tong King Ziang 居住在海宁路774弄P.D.3号。昨日他前往该地址取食物，约在中午12时30分离开时，被六名男子中的两名（上海电力公司罢工者）拦住，劝其随他们前往闸北。Tong 随他们同行，并被带至位于闸北天通庵路寿英坊15号的工会总部。在那里，他受到威胁，若继续工作将面临各种惩罚，随后被释放。在发现该人已被释放之前，来自西虹口的侦探和我先前往了第五区第三分段巡捕房。我们在天通庵路见到了中国警察局人员，在此期间我们等待了35分钟，一名侦探前往工会总部，表面上是去“看看”，但显然是为了警告寿英坊15号的人员租界警察即将到来，随后我们访问了工会办公室。我们要找的那名前往闸北寻找的人并未出现，但以下人员在场：

agreed that the foregoing arrangement should be continued by

confirmed by those who desire the truth, by investigation of

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company - Causes of the present
Strike - Attitude of the General Labour Union
- Attitude of the Management.

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by C.H. Luce

Owing to the uncompromising attitude of the
strikers and their failure to present any demands to
the management, it has, until to-day, been impossible
to form any opinion as to the reason for their discontent.

From the Company's officials and others it
has been learned that the workers generally are not
satisfied with the system under which retiring gratuities
are issued. They feel that the retiring gratuities are
an integral part of their wages and that payment should
be made except in cases where they are removed from the
Company's service for theft or some other serious misconduct.

There have been a number of cases during the past
year where men of five years' service and upwards have left
the Company's employ to find other work. In these cases,
the Company under their regulations governing the
distribution of retiring gratuity, refused to pay. The
workmen reason that in such cases where an employee's
service has been quite satisfactory, he should be paid
in accordance with the length of service.

On the other hand, the Company state that the
retiring gratuity was instituted for the benefit of men of
good character who normally stay with the Company for the
better part of their lives. Besides making provision for
the worker at a period when he will be unable to work the
"gratuity system" has the effect of reducing to a certain
degree the possibility of labour disorders. To carry
this reasoning further, if the Company allowed a man to
retire at any period of his service and paid him his
claims under the "gratuity system" there would be a

制作人 D. S. I. Golder 转呈人 C.H. Luce

由于罢工者态度强硬且未向管理层提出任何诉求，直至今日，仍无法对其不满的原因形成任何看法。

从公司官员及其他人士处获悉，工人们普遍对退休金发放制度感到不满。他们认为退休金是工资的一个组成部分，除非因盗窃或其他严重不当行为被公司解雇，否则均应支付。

在过去的一年中，有多起服务年限五年及以上的员工离开公司另谋工作的案例。在这些案例中，公司根据其退休金分配规定，拒绝支付。工人们认为，在员工表现令人满意的情况下，应按服务年限长短支付退休金。

另一方面，公司表示，设立退休金是为了惠及那些品行端正、通常在公司度过大半生的员工。“退休金制度”除了为工人在无法工作时期提供保障外，还在一定程度上降低了发生劳资纠纷的可能性。进一步推论，如果公司允许员工在任何服务阶段退休并按“退休金制度”支付其应得款项，将会出现

The situation at Riverside Power Station
remains unchanged this morning with one exception. Four Chinese
employed on emergency disconnections have resumed work. They
presented themselves for work on October 5, stating that they
were resuming with the knowledge and approval of the 4th District
Water and Electricity Workers Union who considered that their
work was of vital importance to the public.

In addition 62 chaufuers hitherto shown as
being on strike have been discovered to be working on a normal
basis, thus the number of men affected is reduced to 1491 and
the number of men working increased to 1156.

With reference to the publication in the
October 5th issue of the China Times of news regarding the
Shanghai Power Company labour dispute. The item referring to the
possible affection of the two-boat crews employed by the Company
was brought to the notice of Mr Heald, General Manager. He
contended that should the crews decide to strike it would be
necessary to ensure the safety of the Company's vessels. To
effect this Mr Heald decided that he would obtain the protection
of the River Police through the good offices of Mr.E.S.
Cunningham, Senior Consul.

During an interview with Mr Heald on the

11 Woo Ah Kung (吳阿根) of No 31 Hwa Shing Li, Jukong Road
and P.E. 23 Wong You San (王友山) of No 653 Point Road had
been abducted by members of the strikers whilst working near the
Haig Court on Avenue Haig sometime on October 4, and 5. The
Senior Detective, Bubblingwell was informed of the incident at
4 p.m. October 5. Enquiries made by representatives of Section

今晨江边发电站的局势保持不变，唯有一例例外。四名受雇从事紧急断电工作的中国员工已恢复工作。他们于10月5日到岗，称是在第四区水电工会知情并批准下复工的，该工会认为他们的工作对公众至关重要。

此外，发现此前列为罢工人员的62名司机一直在正常工作，因此受影响人数减少至1491人，工作人数增加至1156人。

关于10月5日《字林西报》（China Times）刊登的涉及上海电力公司劳资纠纷的新闻。其中提及公司所属两艘船只的船员可能受影响一事，已提请总经理希尔德（Heald）先生注意。他主张，如果船员决定罢工，必须确保公司船只的安全。为实现这一目标，希尔德先生决定通过高级领事坎宁安（E.S. Cunningham）先生的斡旋，获得水上警察的保护。

在10月5日下午与希尔德先生的面谈中，他告知我，两名工人，即住在掘江路华兴里31号的P.E. 11 吴阿根（Woo Ah Kung）和住在Point路653号的P.E. 23 王友山（Wong You San），于10月4日和5日的某个时间在爱文义路海格公寓附近工作时，被罢工成员绑架。10月5日下午4时，静安寺捕房高级侦探获悉此事。由科代表进行的调查

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company- Situation.

Made by: D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by: C.H. Fairlie

The situation in the several departments of
the Shanghai Power Company remains unchanged this morning. The
men on shift work, tow-boat crews, clerks, watchmen and men on
contract work (the last item refers to men employed on the
extension of the Company's plant) have all turned up for work.

Attached will be found a table showing the
general situation with details of the trades and other particulars
of those affected, etc.

The increase in the figures of those on strike
does not constitute an increase on yesterdays figures ,but is
accounted for by the inclusion of all miscellaneous workmen
details of which have hitherto not been submitted by the Company.

Referring to my report dated October 2, paragraph 3,
The pay for issue to those on strike was sent to Riverside Station
yesterday morning and prepared for distribution, but so far none
of the men have reported to draw it.

Confirming Mr. Peck's telephone conversation with

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. B. REGIS... Special Branch... Date October 3, 1933)

Subject (in full) Shanghai Power Company- Strike Situation- Delegates of Strikers visit the Shanghai Municipal Council- Union meeting.

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by (签名)

In addition to the 1186 men affected by
the present strike 10 men hitherto employed at the Tonquin
Road sub-station failed to turn up for work this morning
owing, it is claimed, to intimidation by ex-workers from the
Riverside Power Station who visited the Tonquin Road
premises at about 12 noon on October 2.

The shift workers at the Riverside Power Station
all reported for work on October 2. whilst the 7 a.m. shift
to-day have all reported as usual. According to reports from
the Foreign engineers the situation there is very quiet.

Three delegates of the strikers attended the
office of Mr T.K. Ho, Chinese Secretary to the S.M.C. at 4.30
p.m. October 2, when they were informed that the negotiations
with the Company had proved abortive.

Some eighty strikers held a meeting in the
offices of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers
Union, no 15 Shou Ying Faung, off Tiendong Road, Chapei, between
5 and 7 p.m. October 2 when Chu Ah Foh ( 朱 阿 福 ) presided.
He stated that despite mediation by the S.M.C. the Management
of the Shanghai Power Company had refused to compromise, on the
contrary, they intimated that the Company was prepared to cope
with any crisis arising out of the activities of the strikers.

Those present on learning of the Management's
decision became very indignant and decided to despatch pickets
to the vicinity of the Company's various premises at 5 a.m.
each morning to prevent any one from breaking the strike.

Subsequently a secret meeting was held in an
inner room by some ten prominent agitators including Chu Ah Foh
and Tai Kao-lu ( 戴 高 士 ). It was decided to ask the six

撰写人：特别巡捕长 Golder。 呈报人：（签名）

除目前受罢工影响的1186人外，此前在通肯路（Tonquin Road）分站受雇的10名工人今晨未上班，据称是因为10月2日中午12时左右，来自外滩发电站的前往通肯路厂区的离职工人进行了恐吓。

外滩发电站的轮班工人均于10月2日报到上班，而今日早7点的轮班工人也照常全部报到。据外籍工程师报告，当地局势非常平静。

10月2日下午4时30分，三名罢工代表前往工部局华务处长 T.K. Ho 先生的办公室，被告知与公司的谈判已告失败。

10月2日下午5时至7时之间，约八十名罢工者在闸北天通庵路（Tiendong Road）旁寿英坊15号的第四区水电工会办事处举行会议，由朱阿福（Chu Ah Foh）主持。他表示，尽管工部局从中调解，但上海电力公司管理层拒绝妥协；相反，他们暗示公司已准备好应对因罢工者活动而引发的任何危机。

与会者得知管理层的决定后极为愤怒，决定每天清晨5时向公司各处厂区附近派遣纠察队，以防止任何人破坏罢工。

随后，包括朱阿福和戴高士（Tai Kao-lu）在内的约十名主要煽动者在里间举行了一次秘密会议。会议决定要求外滩发电站的六名

October 3. 33.

Shanghai Power Company- Strike Situation- Delegates of
Strikers visit the Shanghai Municipal Council- Union
meeting.

D.S.I. Golder.

In addition to the 1186 men affected by
the present strike 10 men hitherto employed at the Tonquin
Road sub-station failed to turn up for work this morning
owing, it is claimed, to intimidation by ex-workers from the
Riverside Power Station who visited the Tonquin Road
premises at about 12 noon on October 2.

The shift workers at the Riverside Power Station
all reported for work on October 2. whilst the 7 a.m. shift
to-day have all reported as usual. According to reports from
the Foreign engineers the situation there is very quiet.

Three delegates of the strikers attended the
office of Mr T.K. He, Chinese Secretary to the S.M.C. at 4.30
p.m. October 2, when they were informed that the negotiations
with the Company had proved abortive.

Some eighty strikers held a meeting in the
offices of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers
Union, No 15 Shou Ying Fang, off Tiendong Road, Chapei, between
5 and 7 p.m. October 2 when Chu Ah Fah (朱阿福) presided.
He stated that despite mediation by the S.M.C. the Management
of the Shanghai Power Company had refused to compromise; on the
contrary, they intimated that the Company was prepared to cope
with any crisis arising out of the activities of the strikers.

Those present on learning of the Management's
decision became very indignant and decided to despatch pickets
to the vicinity of the Company's various premises at 5 a.m.
each morning to prevent any one from breaking the strike.

Subsequently a secret meeting was held in an
inner room by some ten prominent agitators including Chu Ah Fah
and Tai Kao-lu (戴高土). It was decided to ask the six

1933年10月3日。

上海电力公司——罢工情况——罢工代表拜访上海公共租界工部局——工会会议。

总巡捕戈尔德（Golder）。

除目前受罢工影响的1186人外，此前在通金路（Tonquin Road）分站受雇的10名工人今晨未上班，据称是因为10月2日中午12时左右，来自江边发电站的前往通金路场所的前工人进行了恐吓。

江边发电站的轮班工人均于10月2日报到上班，而今日早7点的轮班人员也均照常报到。据外籍工程师报告，该处局势非常平静。

10月2日下午4时30分，三名罢工代表前往工部局华务秘书何德奎（T.K. He）先生的办公室，被告知与公司的谈判已告失败。

10月2日下午5时至7时之间，约八十名罢工者在闸北天通庵路（Tiendong Road）寿英坊15号第四区水电工人工会办事处举行会议，由朱阿福主持。他表示，尽管工部局从中调解，但上海电力公司管理层拒绝妥协；相反，他们暗示公司准备应对因罢工者活动而引发的任何危机。

与会者得知管理层的决定后极为愤慨，决定每天清晨5时向公司各场所附近派遣纠察队，以防止任何人破坏罢工。

随后，包括朱阿福和戴高土（Tai Kao-lu，音译）在内的约十名主要煽动者在里间举行了一次秘密会议。会议决定要求江边发电站的六名

page_data.en:
-2-
foremen of the Riverside Power Station not to turn up for duty
on October 3, in return for which they should be offered food
and lodging at the expense of the Union. Other resolutions
reached at the meeting were as follows:-
(1) That efforts be made to get a number of strikers into
the various power stations on the pretext of resuming
work or some other excuse in order to induce the workers
on 'shift' to join the strike. Should the workers refuse
threats of violence should be made against their wives
and families.
(2) That all strikers with the exception of those serving on
Communication and Picketing Groups be forbidden to go
near any of the Company's premises and that any one
ignoring the order be treated as strike breakers.
(3) That efforts be made whenever possible to cause damage
to the plant so as to embarrass the Company.
(4).That these resolutions be secretly conveyed to members
of the Communication and Picketing Groups for execution.
During the meeting it was also decided that in view of the
activities of spies and running dogs of the company who gained
access to the meetings under the guise of being news-paper men
any stranger not vouched for by a member of the Union should
be expelled from all meetings of the Union.
At 10.45 a.m. October 2, four representatives of
the Shanghai Power Company strikers,named Hyi Wen-fu ( 沈文富 ),
Chen Pao-keng( 陳寶根 ); Chang Taisung( 張才生 ) and
Pan-keng-ling, called at the Municipality Offices and submitted
a petition for assistance in the present dispute between the

(1) 设法以复工或其他借口让一批罢工者进入各个发电站，以诱使轮班工人加入罢工。如果工人拒绝，则对其妻子和家人进行暴力威胁。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
October 6, 1927.

The Workers of the Shanghai Power Co., Ltd.

At 7 p.m. on October 5, the workers of the
Shanghai Power Co., Ltd. held a meeting at the house of
Mr. Wang Shou-chang, No. 117 Foh Yeu Road, Nantao.
Mr. Wang presided.

The following resolutions were passed:-

1. That ten or twelve groups of twenty persons
each be organised.

2. That Nyi Won-fu be appointed chief of the
supervisory corps.

3. That the strikers be ordered to assemble before
the Power Plant to prevent other workers from entering
work in case the management should dismiss the strikers.

4. That measures of violence be taken against those
workers who secretly resume operations.

5. That subscription groups be organised to solicit
financial assistance from the various labour unions.

6. That the Ministry of Foreign Affairs be requested
to open negotiations with the Shanghai Power Company.

7. That the venue of future meetings be kept secret.

The meeting terminated at 8.30 p.m.

Yesterday being Sunday, the workers remained
at home.

At 2 p.m. the Union of workers of electricity
& waterworks companies of the 4th District ( Shanghai
Power Company) gave an entertainment to a number of
newspapermen at the office of the General Labourers Union
at No. 117 Foh Yeu Road, Nantao. About 20 newspapermen
were present.

1927年10月6日。

上海电力有限公司工人。

10月5日晚7时，上海电力有限公司工人在南市佛佑路（Foh Yeu Road）117号王守昌先生家中举行会议。王先生主持会议。

通过以下决议：

1. 组织十个或十二个小组，每组二十人。

2. 任命倪文富（Nyi Won-fu）为监察队队长。

3. 命令罢工者在发电厂前集合，以防管理层解雇罢工者后其他工人进入工厂工作。

4. 对秘密恢复工作的工人采取暴力措施。

5. 组织募捐小组，向各工会寻求财政援助。

6. 请求外交部与上海电力公司开启谈判。

7. 今后会议的地点保密。

会议于晚8时30分结束。

昨日是星期日，工人们留在家中。

下午2时，第四区水电公司工人工会（上海电力公司）在南市佛佑路117号一般劳工工会办事处招待了一批新闻记者。约有20名记者出席。

- 2 -

Hyi Wen-fu, member of the Standing Committee
of the Union of workers of the Shanghai Power Company,
stated that the management has the intention to dismiss
a certain number of long-service workers under the pretext
of business depression and that it is oppressing its
staff. He requested the newspaper to render assistance
to the strikers.

This morning (October 2) the situation at
Riverside Station remains unchanged.

At the Jesson Road Plant only 30 men
turned up for work at 7 a.m., the 300 hands of this Plant
having joined the strike.

Eighty workers of the depot on Niphong Road
did not appear this morning.

The 300 workers of the Distribution Department
and the 250 workers of the Outdoor Service are at work
normally as also are the 220 workers of the Yangtzew Road
Station.

The 250 workers of the night shift are still
attending to their duties and are being lodged and provided
with food in the Plant.

The Shanghai Municipal Police has detailed a
large number of officers to the various plants of the
Shanghai Power Company as well as to the Head Office on
Nanking Road to prevent disturbances.

On September 13, the Company engaged twenty
Russian workers in addition to the forty taken on on July 3
to replace the strikers.

The strikers have decided to proceed this morning
to the Shanghai Municipal Council and to the Head Office
of the Company on Nanking Road to request the acceptance
of the demands and to wreck transformers in case their
request is rejected

上海电力公司工人工会常务委员会委员沈文富（Hyi Wen-fu）表示，管理层意图以业务萧条为借口解雇一批老员工，并压迫其职员。他请求报纸给予罢工者援助。

今晨（10月2日），江边电站的局势保持不变。

在杰森路（Jesson Road）电厂，只有30人在早上7点上班，该电厂的300名工人已加入罢工。

尼丰路（Niphong Road）仓库的80名工人今晨未出现。

配电部的300名工人和外勤服务的250名工人正常工作，杨树浦路（Yangtzew Road）电站的220名工人也是如此。

夜班的250名工人仍在履行职责，并在电厂内住宿和用餐。

上海公共租界警务处已派遣大量警员前往上海电力公司的各个电厂以及南京路总公司，以防止骚乱。

9月13日，公司在7月3日雇用的四十名俄国工人之外，又雇用了二十名俄国工人，以替代罢工者。

罢工者决定今晨前往上海公共租界工部局和公司位于南京路的总公司，要求接受其诉求，如果要求被拒绝，则破坏变压器

determination to encompass the arrest of Nyi Wen Fu, an ex-worker

In connection with the suggested arrest of Nyi Wen Fu,

Management of the Company

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature]

At 9 a.m. September 30 the Bureau of Social Affairs
and the local Kuomintang detailed representatives to collect
detailed information regarding the 'tai-kung' strike of the
Shanghai Power Company.

At 9.50 a.m. September 30, about ten members of the
4th District Water and Electricity Workers' Union called at
the Bureau of Social Affairs and appealed for assistance in
the existing dispute. They were told that a careful
investigation would be conducted into the case.

At 11 a.m. three representatives including one of
the General Labour Union called on the Management of the
Company at Kiangse Road when the latter explained that,
according to regulations, — the Company do not issue retiring
gratuity to workers dismissed for misconduct. Regarding the
pay of the strikers; the management issued a notice stating
that pay would be issued at Riverside Station on the morning
of October 3. Dissatisfied the callers left the vicinity of
the Company's office at about 11.45 a.m. and proceeded to the
S.M.C. Administration Building where four representatives of
the strikers were interviewed by Mr. J.R. Jones, Secretary
to the Council, Mr. T.K. Ho, Chinese Secretary to the Council,
and Miss Hinder.

Mr. Jones explained to the callers that he was not
conversant with the conditions under which they were employed
but that he would take the matter up with Mr. Heald of the
Shanghai Power Company and render a reply on Monday, October 2.
The representatives left at about 12.25 p.m. whilst the group
of about 400 men dispersed about ten minutes later.

In order to avoid intimidation by the strikers,
