It is reported that during the meeting, the delegates
of the local Kuomintang and the General Labour Union stated
that the dispute will be settled easily if the strike is made
general. They further urged the workers to unite whole-
heartedly in order to gain victory, and that the capitalists
would not bring any further oppression to bear upon the
workers if the latter persist in their present struggle.
Seventeen Chinese journalists were entertained in
the office of the General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yeu Road, City,
at 2.30 p.m. October 1 when Nyi Wen-fu (倪文富), Committee
member of the 4th District Water and Electricity Workers'
Union presided. He stated that the Management of the
Shanghai Power Company had recently aggravated the long
standing dispute existing between them and their workers
with the result that over 120 of them had been not only
dismissed but deprived of their share in the superannuation
fund and bonuses. He added that the uncompromising and
despotic attitude of the Management was so intolerable that
the workers were compelled to rise up and struggle in order
to awaken the Company and expected that the press would

Diary for information of Commissioner of Police

In connection with the statement made by the 4th
District Water and Electricity Workers' Union regarding
the alleged detention of workers in the Riverside Power
Station, it is the management's intention to issue a
notice to-day setting forth that the workmen employed
on the operation of the plant who have remained on the
premises for the past 2 days have done so at their own
request, that they have not been detained by the Company
and are at liberty to leave the plant on the completion
of the daily period of work. It is hoped that this
will have the effect of preventing the families of the
workmen from taking sides with the strikers.

in Workshops, etc.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by

At 11 a.m. September 29, 1933, acting upon the
instructions of the Officer i/c Special Branch, I visited
Mr. Heald, General Manager of the Shanghai Power Company,
for the purposes of obtaining information regarding a
dispute which had that morning become evident at Riverside
Power Station. Mr. Heald made reference to the arrest
of three Shanghai Power Company employees, namely :
Liang Heng-tseng (梁恒珍)
Chao Lien-li (曹連利)
Chow Foh-king (周福金)
who were recently sent to Nanking on suspicion of being
active members of the Communist Party. It was Mr. Heald's
idea to use the arrest of these three men as publicity
on behalf of the Company in the present dispute, but
he eventually decided not to do so. In connection
with the existing difficulty he stated that recently three
workmen, all workshop employees, had either resigned
or were dismissed, the circumstances are as follows :-
1. C.L. 11 Sih Ah-pao. (薛阿宝). This man reported
sick on September 15 and was given two days' leave.
He reported for work on September 16, then absented
himself until September 25. On this date, he
went to the Time Office at Riverside and stated that
he wished to retire and demanded gratuity in addition
to his wages. The gratuity was refused, whereupon
the man declined to accept his wage and so far has
not drawn it.

1933年9月29日上午11时，遵照特别处负责人的指示，我拜访了上海电力公司总经理希尔德（Heald）先生，目的是获取关于当天早上在江边发电站显现的纠纷的信息。希尔德先生提到了三名上海电力公司职员的逮捕，即：
梁恒珍（Liang Heng-tseng）
曹連利（Chao Lien-li）
周福金（Chow Foh-king）
他们近期因涉嫌为共产党活跃分子而被送往南京。希尔德先生原本打算利用这三人的逮捕作为公司在当前纠纷中的宣传手段，但他最终决定不这样做。关于目前的困难，他表示最近有三名工人，均为车间雇员，要么辞职要么被解雇，具体情况如下：
1. C.L. 11 薛阿宝（Sih Ah-pao）。此人于9月15日报病假，获准两天假期。他于9月16日报到上班，随后缺勤至9月25日。当天，他前往江边站的考勤室，表示希望退休，并要求除工资外支付酬金。酬金被拒绝，于是该人拒绝接受其工资，至今尚未支取。

This time, the management dismissed

their superannuation funds which they have
saved up as a result of their hard work.
Representatives have been sent to submit
demands to the management but of no avail.
Feeling enraged, the workers declared a

September 29, 1933.

Shanghai Power Company - "tai-kung" strike at
Riverside Station

At 2.30 p.m. September 28 a deputation
of foremen of the Riverside Power Station interviewed
the Assistant Generation Engineer and demanded the
issue of retiring gratuity to a worker who was
dismissed on September 26 for misconduct. This
demand was turned down and the deputation left. The
same evening a number of workers who had been instructed
to work overtime refused to do so as they wished to
attend a meeting to discuss the matter of the retiring
gratuity to the dismissed employee. At 7 a.m. this
morning, however, the morning shift turned up at
their places, but 90% of their number, about 800,
declared a "tai-kung" strike which continues. The
Company is now considering what steps to take to deal
with the strikers' although neither side has opened
negotiations for a settlement of the dispute.

6. P.

he had accidently broken a piece of machinery in the said
room.    The management failed to pay him either wages,
or superannuation when he was dismissed owing to the fact that
he had received one month's pay at the termination of the
strike in 1933.
    At 3 p.m. on the 17/11/34, Lee Tuh Tsang called at the
General Labour Union, 117 Foh Yue Road, Nantao where he
interviewed Mr. Woo Yue Sung (胡友生).    Mr. Woo promised
to give him assistance on Saturday 24/11/34 when a meeting will
be called to discuss the matter.

                                        I am, Sir,

                                    Your obedient servant,
                                    J. L. Shields,
                                        D. S. I.

先生，
    C.D.S. 63 报告称，上海电力公司第三锅炉房的装配工李德章（Lee Tuh Tsang），在意外损坏该房间的一件机器设备后，于1934年11月15日被负责该部门的外籍主管解雇。由于他在1933年罢工结束时已领取了一个月的工资，管理方在他被解雇时未向其支付工资或养老金。

Yangtzepoo...... Station,
REPORT
Date.. Nov... 25th, ...... 19 34.

Subject (in full).................... Worker dismissed from the S.P.C. Riverside Station....................

Made by..... D.S.I. White .................... Forwarded by.... Officer i/c [Signature]

Sir,

C.D.S. 63 reports that at 2 p.m. 24/11/34, 45 workers of the
Shanghai Power Company proceeded to the General Labour Union,
117 Poh Yue Road, Nantao, where they reported that an ex-worker
named Li Tuh Tsang ( 李德章 ) (vide report 19/11/34) of the
above company was dismissed on the 15/11/34 and requested that
the union demands superannuation from Shanghai Power Company on
behalf for the dismissed worker.

At 7.15 p.m. 24/11/34, a representative of the Union, Yih
Ziang Kao ( 葉翔皋 ) informed the above workers that a meeting
could not be held due to same being prohibited by Chinese
Authorities. The Union representative further stated that
the Union does not wish to be responsible for negotiations with
the management of the Shanghai Power Company about the matter,
owing to the fact that this ex-worker did not pay his monthly
union fee whilst employed by the above company.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,
R J White
D. S. I.

REPORT
Subject (in full) Notice posted by the management of the Riverside
Power Station.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Shields
Sir,
At 8.10 a.m. 18/5/34, C.D.S. 63 reported that at 5 p.m. on
16/5/34 a notice was posted by the management of S.P.C. in the
Riverside Power Station, 2800 Yangtzepoo Road. Translation
as follows:
"A petition from all workers of this company has been
received requesting us to alter the scheme for refunding the
loan which the management gave after the strike.
To render assistance to all workers the management has
approved of their request and hereby cancel the previous
agreement, i.e. to be deducted from their wages every month,
and permission is hereby given that workers will refund their
loan from the bonus which is due to them. Workers when
dismissed by the company or on resigning should refund the
loan from any money due to them."
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. I. Shields
D. S. I.

主题（全称）江边发电站管理层张贴的告示。
制作及转呈人 D.S.I. Shields
先生，
1934年5月18日上午8时10分，C.D.S. 63 报告称，1934年5月16日下午5时，上海电力公司管理层在杨树浦路2800号的江边发电站张贴了一则告示。译文如下：
“本公司全体工人提交了一份请愿书，要求我们更改管理层在罢工后提供贷款的偿还方案。
为了援助全体工人，管理层已批准他们的请求，特此取消之前的协议，即每月从工资中扣除款项；现准许工人从应得的奖金中偿还贷款。工人若被公司解雇或辞职，应从任何欠付他们的款项中偿还贷款。”
此致，

您顺从的仆人，
J. I. Shields
